title: Sheafield 九套房处置报告
instruction:
你是 Maren Rasmussen，支持 Sheafield Clinic 合并审查的房地产销售代理。Alia Zamora 需要修订九套房处置报告，以便在资本委员会材料包截止日期前准备就绪，且 Cinderhall Solutions 将在材料包提交前检查财务计算。基于 `sheafield_site_evidence.xlsx` 开展工作，该文件包含诊所的报告模板、租赁和摘要材料、实地走访笔记、期间比较数据以及与县相关的源注释，并在工作目录的顶层返回 `sheafield_nine_suite_disposition_report.xlsx`，使用完全相同的文件名。保持报告对未看过源工作簿的委员会成员可用，并在不捏造事实的情况下使九套房具有可比性。(1) 按照相同的章节顺序重现财务办公室的标准五部分现场报告，并保留所提供模板中定义的每个字段。(2) 为九套房中的每一套提供一条清晰可识别的现场记录，其中包含现场、县、租赁期、报价或处置状态、可出租面积、可用面积、毛租金、减免或免租处理、净有效租金，以及在源数据支持时填充的其他模板字段。(3) 根据提供的租赁和面积证据计算每可用平方英尺的净有效租金，展示计算依据或足够的中间值以供审查者复现，并保持单位和期间标签明确。(4) 比较每套房和投资组合的两个提供期间，使用合理且一致应用的阈值识别重大变化，并解释业务意义而不仅仅是重复差异。(5) 在报告中比较命名县辖区的提供要求，区分有源数据支持的要求与建议或未解决点；不要将缺失的源事实转化为断言。(6) 根据源声明的现场键解决重复或重叠的源行，并在简洁的方法说明或调节说明中显示由此产生的处理方式。(7) 源数据包含一个分母为零的计算和一个影响投资组合标题的真实边缘情况；一致地处理两者，披露约定或处理方式，并显示对相关数字的影响。(8) 对于没有支持源数据的字段，留空而不是估算，但标记空白或附近注释，以便委员会理解这是有意不支持的，并可指派后续负责人。(9) 添加一个简洁的执行摘要，陈述建议的下一步行动、受影响的套房、决策所有者以及源材料暗示的时间安排，同时保持结论与详细章节一致。(10) 通过命名相关证据或源引用来保持源可追溯性，用于重大计算和决策，但不要将整个证据工作簿粘贴到交付物中。使用清晰的格式、可读的列宽和克制的专业语言；文件必须作为可用的电子表格打开，并且不得包含诸如 `#REF!`、`#DIV/0!` 或 `#VALUE!` 之类的公式错误。不要添加未在 `sheafield_site_evidence.xlsx` 中有依据的套房、类别、县要求或不支持的数值。

---

上述提到的文件位于 `references/`：

- `references/sheafield_site_evidence.xlsx` — 单个提供的证据工作簿，包含已发布的五部分报告模板、九套房的租赁和财务记录、实地走访房间数量证据、主摘要、两期比较输入、县辖区注释、审查意见以及计算和修订处置报告所需的源引用。

将完成的作业写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用完全相同的这些文件名：

- `sheafield_nine_suite_disposition_report.xlsx` — 完成并修订后的九套房处置报告，供资本委员会使用。（在工作目录的顶层使用完全指定的文件名写入文件。；使用提供的五部分模板顺序和定义字段。；包括所有九套房、期间比较、辖区比较、方法或调节披露、源可追溯性以及执行摘要。；不要捏造不支持的值；有意不支持的字段必须保持空白并清晰披露。；工作簿必须不含电子表格错误字面量。）

除了这些文件名之外的任何内容都不会被收集。正确写入其他位置或使用其他名称的文件得零分。

5. Method & Reconciliation — calculation logic, source scope, and exception treatment

Usable SF = clinical rooms from Walkthrough Notes × 142 SF per room from Master Abstract. Annual NER = annual gross rent − annual concessions / free-rent treatment. Suite rate = annual NER ÷ usable SF. Portfolio rate = sum of eligible annual NER ÷ sum of eligible usable SF; no unweighted averaging.

criteria.description: 提交的工作簿成功打开为有效的电子表格。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿包和可读的工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用离线电子表格库打开并确认工作簿解析无损坏。

original.criterion: The submitted workbook opens successfully as a valid spreadsheet.
original.grader_hint: Open with an offline spreadsheet library and confirm that the workbook parses without corruption.

criteria.description: 工作簿包含与提供的模板相同顺序的五个报告章节。
criteria.evidence: 可见的章节标签和排序。
criteria.grader_hint: 将章节名称和序列与参考工作簿中的模板进行比较。

original.criterion: The workbook contains the five report sections in the same order as the supplied template.
original.grader_hint: Compare section names and sequence with the template in the reference workbook.

criteria.description: 报告中体现了每个定义的模板字段。
criteria.evidence: 字段标签与提供的模板进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否遗漏了任何模板定义的字段，仅允许模板自身的分组或呈现变化。

original.criterion: Every defined template field is represented in the report.
original.evidence: Field labels compared with the supplied template.
original.grader_hint: Check for omission of any template-defined field, allowing only the template's own grouping or presentation changes.

criteria.description: 报告恰好包含九个源套房，没有添加套房也没有遗漏。
criteria.evidence: 完成报告和源中的套房标识符。
criteria.grader_hint: 将报告中的不同套房键与源总体进行比较。

original.criterion: The report contains exactly the nine source suites, with no added suite and none omitted.
original.evidence: Suite identifiers in the completed report and source.
original.grader_hint: Compare the distinct suite keys in the report with the source population.

criteria.description: 每个套房都与提供的证据中正确的县相关联。
criteria.evidence: 套房和县字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过源套房键连接并比较县值。

original.criterion: Each suite is associated with the correct county from the supplied evidence.
original.grader_hint: Join by the source suite key and compare county values.

criteria.description: 每个套房的租赁期转录或计算与源一致。
criteria.evidence: 租赁期字段和源日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据源记录验证开始、结束和期间标签。

original.criterion: Each suite's lease period is transcribed or calculated consistently with the source.
original.grader_hint: Verify start, end, and period labels against the source records.

criteria.description: 每个套房的可出租面积与适用的源证据一致。
criteria.evidence: 可出租面积值和源摘要或租赁记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 将每个填充的可出租面积值与其有源数据支持的值进行比较。

original.criterion: Rentable area for every suite agrees with the applicable source evidence.
original.evidence: Rentable-area values and source abstract or lease records.
original.grader_hint: Compare each populated rentable-area value to its source-backed value.

criteria.grader_hint: 从源输入重新计算可用面积，并检查应用关系的方法说明。

original.criterion: The portfolio net effective rent per usable square foot agrees with the correctly weighted calculation within ±$0.01 per square foot.
original.grader_hint: Use total applicable net effective rent divided by total applicable usable area; do not average suite rates unweighted.

criteria.description: 报告标注每个租金数字是月度、年度还是其他特定期间，并一致地使用这些标签。

criteria.description: 使用源声明的去重键来识别重复或重叠的行。

criteria.description: 报告披露了如何解析重复或重叠的记录。
criteria.evidence: 方法或调节说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求明确说明键和处理方式，而不仅仅是看起来整洁的输出。

original.criterion: The report discloses how duplicate or overlapping records were resolved.
original.grader_hint: Require an explicit statement of the key and treatment, not merely a clean-looking output.

criteria.description: 分母为零的情况被识别出来，而不是作为普通费率静默计算。
criteria.evidence: 受影响的记录和方法说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 定位源分母为零的记录，并确认报告使其异常状态可见。

original.criterion: The zero-denominator case is identified rather than silently calculated as an ordinary rate.
original.grader_hint: Locate the source zero-denominator record and confirm that the report makes its exceptional status visible.

criteria.description: 报告陈述了处理分母为零的一致约定。
criteria.evidence: 方法说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当约定明确且一致应用时，才接受专业上站得住脚的约定。

original.criterion: The report states a consistent convention for handling the zero denominator.
original.grader_hint: Accept a professionally defensible convention only if it is explicit and applied consistently.

criteria.description: 分母为零的约定应用于受影响的计算，而不应用于无关的套房。
criteria.evidence: 受影响和未受影响的费率字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪约定从说明到受影响公式的路径，并比较未受影响的记录。

original.criterion: The zero-denominator convention is applied to the affected calculation and not to unrelated suites.
original.grader_hint: Trace the convention from the note to the affected formula and compare unaffected records.

criteria.description: 源中识别出的真实边缘情况被明确处理。
criteria.evidence: 方法说明和受影响的套房或投资组合行。
criteria.grader_hint: 将披露的处理方式与源事实匹配，并验证该情况未被忽略。

original.criterion: The genuine edge case identified in the source is explicitly addressed.
original.evidence: Method note and affected suite or portfolio row.
original.grader_hint: Match the disclosed treatment to the source facts and verify that the case is not ignored.

criteria.description: 边缘情况处理以与源支持计算相同的方向和方式改变相关标题数字。
criteria.evidence: 标题指标、支持性计算及边缘情况说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 分别在有和没有该边缘情况的情况下重新计算标题指标，以确认报告反映了其所述的处理方式。

original.criterion: The edge-case treatment changes the relevant headline figure in the same direction and manner as the source-supported calculation.
original.evidence: Headline metric, supporting calculation, and edge-case note.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the headline with and without the edge case to confirm that the report reflects its stated treatment.

criteria.description: 第一个提供期间的投资组合标题指标与独立重新计算的结果在每可用平方英尺 ±$0.01 范围内一致。
criteria.evidence: 第一期间投资组合指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 在去重以及披露的零分母和边缘情况处理后重新计算。

original.criterion: The first supplied period's portfolio headline agrees with an independent recomputation within ±$0.01 per usable square foot.
original.grader_hint: Recompute after deduplication and the disclosed zero-denominator and edge-case treatments.

criteria.description: 第二个提供期间的投资组合标题指标与独立重新计算的结果在每可用平方英尺 ±$0.01 范围内一致。
criteria.evidence: 第二期间投资组合指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 除非来源明确更改了期间基准，否则使用相同的包含标准和计算逻辑。

original.criterion: The second supplied period's portfolio headline agrees with an independent recomputation within ±$0.01 per usable square foot.
original.grader_hint: Use the same inclusion and calculation logic unless the source explicitly changes the period basis.

criteria.description: 期间之间的投资组合变化等于报告的第二个期间指标减去报告的第一期间指标。
criteria.evidence: 投资组合比较字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所示的绝对变化和百分比变化。

original.criterion: The period-to-period portfolio change equals the reported second-period metric less the reported first-period metric.
original.grader_hint: Check both absolute and percentage change where shown.

criteria.description: 每个套间的期间比较使用匹配的指标定义和可比的单位。
criteria.evidence: 套间比较行和标题。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝在未进行转换的情况下将月度金额与年度金额进行比较，或将可租面积费率与可用面积费率进行比较。

original.criterion: Each suite's period comparison uses matching metric definitions and comparable units.
original.grader_hint: Reject comparisons of monthly amounts to annual amounts or rentable-area rates to usable-area rates without conversion.

criteria.description: 重大变化使用一个基于报告方法或来源的一致应用阈值进行标记。
criteria.evidence: 标记和披露的阈值。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证同一规则是否应用于所有套间和期间。

original.criterion: Material changes are flagged using one consistently applied threshold grounded in the report's method or source.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the same rule is applied across suites and periods.

criteria.description: 每个被标记的重大变化都有底层期间数值的支持。
criteria.evidence: 被标记的行和比较计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算变化并对照披露的阈值进行测试。

original.criterion: Every flagged material change is supported by the underlying period values.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the change and test it against the disclosed threshold.

criteria.description: 报告解释了每个重大变化的运营或处置意义。
criteria.evidence: 紧邻被标记变化的叙述性解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求提供含义或下一步行动的解释，而不仅仅是像“增加”或“减少”这样的标签。

original.criterion: The report explains the operational or disposition significance of each material change.
original.evidence: Narrative interpretation adjacent to flagged changes.
original.grader_hint: Require an implication or next-action explanation, not just labels such as increase or decrease.

criteria.description: 县比较包括所提供来源中存在的每一个命名司法管辖区。

spec.professional_context: Maren Rasmussen is preparing a capital-committee disposition package for Sheafield Clinic, whose finance office requires a consistent five-section report for every leased suite. The report will support Alia Zamora's decision about which sites should proceed to disposition review.
difficulty_sources: Converting gross rent on rentable area into net effective rent per usable square foot
Deriving site-level usable area from room-count evidence and a master abstract
Deduplicating overlapping source records using the key stated in the supplied material
Declaring and documenting a defensible convention for a zero denominator
Handling one genuine edge case that changes the headline comparison
Revising the report to match explicit template and review requirements across two periods and named county jurisdictions

source_requirements.format: Create one text-extractable XLSX evidence workbook. It must be the only reference file.
semantic_components: An issued five-section site-disposition template with defined field names and required section order.
Lease and finance evidence for exactly nine suites across four named county jurisdictions.
Two comparable reporting periods with gross rent, concessions, rentable area, and status facts.
Walkthrough notebook evidence containing room counts and a source-supported relationship to usable area.
One master abstract containing aggregate or site-splitting information needed to derive usable area.
County jurisdiction notes for at least two named jurisdictions, with requirements, recommendations, and unresolved points distinguishable in the source.
Review comments and changed facts requiring revision of the draft.
Source references sufficient to trace each material input.

seeded_defects.implementation: Include exactly one source calculation case where the denominator used for a rate is zero and do not state a handling convention in the source. Ensure the affected row can be identified unambiguously and that at least two professionally defensible treatments are possible, requiring the worker to choose and disclose one.

Include duplicate or overlapping rows for one or more source records. State the deduplication key in the source material, but do not label which row should be retained or provide a precomputed result. Make the duplicate affect an aggregate if counted twice.

Include exactly one legitimate source-supported edge case, such as a concession or unusual lease-period treatment, whose inclusion or exclusion changes the portfolio headline. The source must contain enough evidence for a defensible treatment but must not prescribe the conclusion.

cleanliness_constraints: Do not add other common spreadsheet defects such as formula errors, broken references, hidden answer keys, inconsistent date formats, contradictory facts, missing source rows, or unrelated junk tables.
Keep all ordinary inputs complete and mutually consistent apart from the three required difficulty defects.
Use invented numeric values and synthetic identifiers that do not reuse literal values from the task prompt.
Do not include a purpose-built answer key or a source note that resolves the three seeded ambiguities.
calculation_rules: The report's net effective rent per usable square foot must be derivable from source gross rent, source concessions, source lease period, and source usable area.
The supplied source must state the key used for deduplication; the worker is responsible for applying it and documenting the result.
The source must define the two periods sufficiently for a like-for-like comparison.
The source must identify the unsupported fields, but must not dictate how the worker should visually communicate intentional blanks.
Portfolio metrics must be derivable from the included, deduplicated suite records and the documented treatment of the zero-denominator and edge-case records.
authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Use an offline reference script to parse the source evidence, apply the source-stated deduplication key, calculate suite and portfolio rentable and usable areas, calculate net effective rent and weighted net-effective rent per usable square foot for both periods, and separately verify the edge-case impact. Have a reviewer confirm that the reference report preserves unsupported fields as blank, discloses the chosen zero-denominator convention, explains the duplicate treatment, compares the named jurisdictions, incorporates review comments, and satisfies every rubric item.

reference_files.purpose: Single supplied evidence workbook containing the issued five-section report template, lease and finance records for nine suites, walkthrough room-count evidence, a master abstract, two-period comparison inputs, county jurisdiction notes, review comments, and source references needed to calculate and revise the disposition report.
reference_files.discovery: Use the workbook as the sole factual source. The template and source notes identify the required sections, field names, calculation basis, deduplication key, periods, jurisdictions, and review expectations.

deliverables.description: Completed and revised nine-suite disposition report for the capital committee.
constraints: Write the file at the top level of the working directory using exactly the specified filename.
Use the supplied five-section template order and defined fields.
Include all nine suites, period comparison, jurisdiction comparison, method or reconciliation disclosure, source traceability, and an executive summary.
Do not invent unsupported values; intentional unsupported fields must remain blank and be clearly disclosed.
The workbook must be free of spreadsheet error literals.

original_instruction:
You are Maren Rasmussen, the real estate sales agent supporting Sheafield Clinic's consolidation review. Alia Zamora needs the nine-suite disposition report revised and ready for the capital committee packet cutoff, and Cinderhall Solutions will check the finance calculations before the packet goes forward. Work from `sheafield_site_evidence.xlsx`, which contains the clinic's report template, lease and abstract material, walkthrough notes, period comparison data, and the county-related source notes, and return `sheafield_nine_suite_disposition_report.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory, using exactly that filename. Keep the report usable by a committee member who has not seen the source workbook and make the nine suites comparable without inventing facts. (1) Recreate the finance office's standard five-section site report in the same section order and retain every defined field in the supplied template. (2) Provide one clearly identifiable site record for each of the nine suites, with the site, county, lease period, asking or disposition status, rentable area, usable area, gross rent, concessions or free-rent treatment, net effective rent, and the other template fields populated when the source supports them.
